title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat on Android: choose style and format, and apply a brand kit, for visual creations
summary: The briefing passes: the Android roadmap facts, brand kit permissions, admin paths and commands are supported. Minor corrections should cite the separate iOS roadmap item and acknowledge that the Cloud Policy documentation permits additional administrator roles.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; controls[0].governs; Why it matters
claims.claim: The brand manager policy grants official kit publishing, editing and management rights to members of its mail-enabled security group.
claims.quote: Enterprise Brand Manager policy | Who can publish, edit, and manage official brand kits. | Members of the brand manager mail-enabled security group specified in the policy.

claims.claim: Group ownership alone does not grant permission to publish or edit official brand kits.
claims.quote: Group membership grants policy access. Group owners can manage the group, but ownership alone doesn't grant permission to publish or edit official brand kits.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The two brand kit policies are independent.
claims.quote: The policies are independent. To publish a personal brand kit as an official brand kit, a user must satisfy both policy checks.

claims.claim: A brand manager outside the creation group cannot create or edit brand kits under these policies.
claims.quote: C | No | Yes | Can't create or edit brand kits because the creation policy requirement isn't satisfied.

claims.claim: Publishing a personal kit as official requires passing both group policy checks.
claims.quote: To publish a personal brand kit as an official brand kit, a user must satisfy both policy checks.

claims.claim: The creation policy controls which group members may create and edit personal brand kits.
claims.quote: Restrict brand kit creation policy | Who can create and edit personal brand kits. | Members of the mail-enabled security group specified in the policy.

claims.claim: Users outside the creation group do not see the option to create a brand kit when the restriction is configured.
claims.quote: Users outside this group don't see the option to create a brand kit.

claims.claim: A user outside the permitted group receiving a shared brand kit with edit rights can only view it.
claims.quote: If a user who isn't in the permitted group receives a shared brand kit with edit rights, the user can only view the kit.

claims.claim: Such a user sees the stated admin-restriction message when opening the shared kit.
claims.quote: Your admin has restricted the rights for brand kit creation and editing. Please contact your admin for permission.

claims.claim: Microsoft's brand kit prerequisites include creating an organisation assets library in SharePoint.
claims.quote: Before users can create and publish brand kits, complete the following prerequisites: ... Create an organization assets library to connect to Copilot.

claims.claim: The Copilot settings page says creating Cloud Policy settings requires the Office Apps admin role.

claims.claim: AI Administrator is an appropriate role for managing Copilot settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The official-kit policy is reached in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center at Customization > Policy Management > policy > Policies > Elevated role for Brand Managers.
claims.quote: select Customization > Policy Management. ... Select an existing tenant-level policy ... Select the Policies tab. ... select Elevated role for Brand Managers.

claims.claim: No API or automation operation is documented for setting the official brand manager policy.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph Cloud Policy brand kit creation Enterprise Brand Manager powershell API; "Elevated role for Brand Managers" "Graph". Read brand kit governance, copilotPolicySetting and TCM supported resources; no relevant operation.

claims.claim: The personal-kit policy is reached at Customization > Policy Management > policy > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Restrict brand kit creation in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: select Customization > Policy Management. ... Select an existing tenant-level policy ... On the Start with the basics page ... On the Choose the scope page ... On the Configure Settings page ... Select Restrict brand kit creation.

claims.claim: No API or automation operation is documented for setting Restrict brand kit creation.
claims.quote: Searched: Elevated role Brand Managers Restrict brand kit creation API Graph Cloud Policy automation; "Restrict brand kit creation" "API". Read brand kit governance, copilotPolicySetting and TCM supported resources; Advertising brand kit operations concern another product.

claims.claim: The image generation setting is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center at Copilot > Settings > Copilot actions > Copilot image generation.
claims.quote: Copilot image generation | Allow or prevent supported image-generation experiences. | Copilot > Settings > Copilot actions > Copilot image generation.

claims.claim: PATCH /beta/copilot/admin/policySettings/{id} updates the Copilot policy setting.
claims.quote: Update the value of a Copilot policy setting. ... PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/policySettings/{id}

claims.claim: microsoft.copilot.imagegeneration is a supported identifier for the image generation policy.
claims.quote: microsoft.copilot.imagegeneration | Control access to Designer Image Generation

claims.claim: The update request body sets the value property.
claims.quote: value | String | The new value to set for the setting. ... Required.

claims.claim: The policySettings API is beta.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: The policySettings API supports only tenant-level policies.
claims.quote: only tenant-level policies are supported. User-level and group-level policies aren't supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the image generation setting specifically disables Android style and format choices.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot image generation" "Android" "style". Read Copilot settings, overview, policySettings and TCM imagegeneration: they cover supported image generation including BizChat/Visual Creator, but do not say whether Android style/format choices themselves disappear.

claims.claim: The policySettings reference lists no supported brand kit policy identifier.
claims.quote: Searched: Elevated role Brand Managers Restrict brand kit creation API Graph Cloud Policy automation. Read the complete copilotPolicySetting supported-settings table: pinning, open content, imagegeneration, web search and admin centers; no brand kit identifier.

claims.claim: User licence assignment is reached in Microsoft 365 admin center at Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user ... select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a licence using Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()
